The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that the compound may modulate the expression or activity of the target proteins involved. The evidence supports a plausible pathway, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and functional impact of (Hydroxyethyloxy)Tri(Ethyloxy)Octane on Outer membrane protein G.
